text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ーー*inhale*... *exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san... looks intensely focused, 
doesn't she!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she's completely ready to face 
her. 
Now then, I wonder how this'll all turn 
out...♪

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“ーーMejiro McQueen has been standing 
there like that for quite some time. 
Could she be focusing her mind while 
waiting for Gold Ship?”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama the Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Rather than wasting stamina 
searching all over the island, 
she wants a fair and square duel in an 
open area... That's probably her game 
plan.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama the Commentator
text_block_list.text:
That other one ought to notice soon 
and make her way over here, but... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“—Ugh, uwooo! And we were supposed to be 
the ultimate battery! 
We promised we'd make it to nationals 
together...!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“At least let me fill a bottle with this 
pure white sand to take home... 
To entrust our dreams to the 
underclassmen...!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“UGHHAAAAAAAARRRRGGHH!! 
And that's why we're settling this, 
McQueen!!”

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“...!? I have no idea what's going on, but 
Gold Ship 
seems to be raring to go!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“What do you mean, 'that's why'!? 
Everyone is utterly bewildered by you!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“May I say one thing before we fight? We 
do have a bet, yes, 
but please do not forget that first and 
foremost, this is an official academy 
event.”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“I will not get so carried away in the 
heat of battle that I lose sight of my 
surroundings. 
I aim for a victory worthy of everyone 
watching, so keep that in mind.”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“...Huuuuh? What the hell're you talkin' 
about...? 
So basically... what? Huh...?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“We are pressed for time. 
Let us cease this chatter and begin.”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“—Whoa, whoa, whoa, what's with all that 
boring-ass garbage? 
What is that even supposed to mean!? 
AAAAAHHH!?!???”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“Wh-What is it? Why are you suddenly 
shouting...?”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: “BOOOOOORING!!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Boring, boring, boring, boring, boring, 
boring! 
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOORRRRRIIIIIIINGGGG!!!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: G-Gold Ship!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Aaaahhh... so boring... 
I'm so over it... totally lost 
interestttt...”

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Wha... Whaaaaaaaat!!?

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“Wh-What a shocking turn of events! 
Gold Ship has suddenly completely lost the 
will to fight...!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“L-Lost interest...? What on earth are you 
saying? 
Come now, get up this instant! If you 
don't stand up, I shall shoot you!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Go ahead and shoot... Ugh, such a drag... 
I'm melting...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“How utterly selfish... Listen here, 
please have a little more consideration 
for the people around you—”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“Pfft... Hahaha... That's Golshi for ya. 
She's seriously nuts.”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“...Ahahaha, that's hilarious...! 
Ahahahahaha!”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Fufufu! Come on, McQueen-chan! 
Now's your chance! Go get 'er~!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“No way! Get up, Golshi-san! 
You defeated me, so hang in there till the 
very end~!”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
“Hehehe... What an upset. 
This is why I can't take my eyes off her.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Why is everyone having so much fun...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Selfish... is it? Does that mean everyone 
has already accepted her wild antics long 
ago...люб?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Was I simply worrying too much... 
thinking that 'acting selfishly would only 
trouble others'?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it... even the reporters 
listened to my wishes without a hint of 
displeasure...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(That is right. They laughed and accepted 
my selfishness... my shortcomings... did 
they not...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“...What have I been hesitating for all 
this time? 
I truly still have much to learn...!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Haaaah... I can't do today anymore... 
I'm going hoooome~.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“...Gold Ship-san, may I have a moment? 
*Ahem*...”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: “Whaddya want? I told ya, I lost inter—”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“—SILENCE! 
I will NOT permit you to forfeit this 
match!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: “—Ah! M-McQueen-san just...!”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Totally snapped, didn't she!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“You are taking your whims far too far!! 
What do you mean, 'lost interest'!? That 
is quite enough of your nonsense!!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Whoa, whoa, whoa... What's got you so 
heated? 
Weren't you the one saying you wouldn't do 
that kind of thing?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“I retract my previous statement! More 
than that, 
I have realized that teaching you a lesson 
is far more important!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“I will not allow you to go home! 
Fight me seriously! We are going to settle 
this bet once and for all!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“...Now that's a proper look on your 
face.”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Buuut, what should I doooo~? 
Golshi-chan doesn't wanna do stuff that 
ain't fun, y'know~?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“If you win, I shall accompany you in your 
other games as well! 
Be it searching for giant squids or 
playing kemari, I will join you!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“For real!? You promise! You'd better do 
it! 
If you're lying, I'm gonna make you 
swallow a thousand salmon sticks, you hear 
meee?!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“ALRIIIIIGHT!!! Let's DO THISSS!!! 
I ain't holdin' back, 
ORAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!”
